# NeuralNg Slider

IMPORT
import { NeuralSlider, type NeuralSliderEvent, type NeuralSliderRangeValue } from '@neural-ng/core/slider';

RULES
- NeuralSlider is canonical. SliderComponent is a deprecated compatibility alias; never generate it in new code.
- Bind a number for single mode or a [number, number] tuple when range is true.
- Native range semantics provide Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End.
- min, max and step normalize invalid bounds and steps.
- orientation accepts horizontal or vertical. Range track clicks follow logical RTL direction.
- Give range thumbs distinct rangeStartAriaLabel and rangeEndAriaLabel values.
- rangeStartAriaValueText and rangeEndAriaValueText describe non-obvious numeric values.
- showValue renders output; valueLabel overrides its text.
- slideStart, slideEnd, valueCommit and touch are semantic user events.
- readonly remains focusable and blocks mutation; disabled prevents interaction.
- NeuralSlider supports Signal Forms, Reactive Forms and ngModel.
- unstyled preserves native inputs, dimensions and structural hooks.
- Typed class slots are root, input, value, range, track and fill.
